08-31-1440 is August 31, 1440.  
16 weeks + 7 days = 17 weeks = 119 days.  
Subtract 119 days from August 31, 1440.  
August has 31 days, so going back:  
Aug 31 - 119 days = Aug 31 → July (31 days in July) → back to June, etc.  

Step:  
From Aug 31:  
Back 31 days → July 31.  
Back another 30 days (June) → July 1 becomes June 1? Let's compute directly:  

119 days back from Aug 31, 1440:  
August: 31 days (0 days into August means Aug 31 is day 0? Better to count days remaining in previous months.)  

Actually, simpler:  
Days from start of year to Aug 31 in 1440 (leap year? 1440 divisible by 4 and 100 and 400? 1440 divisible by 4 = 360, yes; divisible by 100 = 14.4, no; so leap year).  
Jan 31, Feb 29, Mar 31, Apr 30, May 31, Jun 30, Jul 31, Aug 31 → sum:  
31+29+31+30+31+30+31+31 = 244 days (Aug 31 is day 245 if Jan 1 is day 1).  

So Aug 31 = day 245.  
245 - 119 = day 126 of the year.  

Day 126 in leap year:  
Jan 31 (31), Feb 29 (60), Mar 31 (91), Apr 30 (121).  
126 - 121 = 5 → May 5.  

Thus new date = 1440-05-05.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1440-05-05
